field_defaults.marketing_objectives: Develop a training deck that familiarizes the field with approved core materials and how to use them with HCPs.
field_defaults.tactic_objectives: Educate the sales force on leveraging in-market materials at launch; include annotations where reps should focus discussion.
field_defaults.deliverables:
Training deck covering each core material slide-by-slide: objective of each page, details for HCP dialogue, known objection handling.
Outputs: presentation file and PDF for review; speaker notes as needed.
field_defaults.key_messages: Align to brand strategy and PI-based claims only; note any N/A sections pending MLR.
field_defaults.art_pd_xd:
Leverage existing annotated training deck template where applicable; maintain brand design system.
Each slide: Internal Only / Confidential disclaimer.
Include end matter / thank-you slide.
field_defaults.mandatories: Same design mandatories as reference template; internal-only labeling; final thank-you slide with disclaimer.
field_defaults.submission_files: Files prepared per client submission guidelines; annotations per AMA where applicable for RC.
field_defaults.reviews: Multiple client reviews for message and layout; RC reviews (initial layout + final proof).
field_defaults.asset_checklist:
Deck with speaker notes; PDF; internal distribution.
Branded / non-OPDP release per routing.
field_defaults.creative_asset_needs: Confirm: Veeva code on piece; ISI requirements; PI insert; internal-only flag.
field_defaults.development_submission_needs: PDF vs mechanical timing; comp requirements; hosting (e.g. Veeva Exchange); submission type (New/Successor); annotations/fact-check; marketing notes.
field_defaults.scope_roles_deliverables:
Integrated producer: timeline, approvals, RC packages.
Copy: brief-led copy, annotations for RC, RC meetings.
Art: direction to presentation services.
Edit: fact-check, reference updates, layout reads.
Submissions: Veeva upload, queries, vault/Promomats.
Presentation services: deck design per AD, PPT + PDF, brand compliance.
field_defaults.client_approvals_rounds: Estimate client review rounds before final JRC; client review-day allocation; JRC rounds forecast; target in-market window; rate card / SOW treatment.
field_defaults.appendix: Link to workflow timeline (e.g. Workfront) when available.

field_defaults.marketing_objectives: Increase HCP understanding of mechanism / clinical narrative; drive clicks to deeper clinical or MOA content.
field_defaults.barrier_opportunity: Opportunity: reach HCPs in professional feed with concise video; barrier: prior asset built for another placement — resize/repurpose for LinkedIn.
field_defaults.tactic_objectives: Deliver LinkedIn in-feed video unit adapted from approved reference creative; include variable copy/CTA options where needed.
field_defaults.deliverables:
LinkedIn MOA (or campaign) video aligned to reference job code.
Multiple post copy and CTA options for submission flexibility.
Storyboard frames + mocked post (desktop/mobile).
field_defaults.specs_reference:
LinkedIn in-feed video (common guidance): MP4; AAC/MPEG4 audio; ~30 fps; destination URL with http(s); headline ~70 chars visible; intro text ~150 chars (verify current LinkedIn specs).
Aspect ratios to consider: 1:1 (square), 4:5 vertical, 16:9 landscape — confirm media plan.
Duration often short-form for feed (e.g. ~15–30s creative target; platform allows wider range).
field_defaults.copy_requirements:
Reserve first-line legal/post copy as required by brand (e.g. PI link).
Provide headline + description variants so copy can refresh without full resubmit where policy allows.
Ensure continuity from ad → landing experience.
field_defaults.art_pd_xd:
Resize/rebuild animation from source creative; maintain ISI treatment per social guidance.
XD: LinkedIn post mockups with storyboard for desktop/mobile.
Full LOI/ISI presentation during full-screen states as required.
field_defaults.tech_dev_deployment:
Broadcast produces/resizes video per approved storyboard.
Hand MP4 to media agency for trafficking; UTMs per tracking sheet.
field_defaults.reviews: Client reviews on storyboard/mockups; PRB rounds with mockup then video attachment as applicable.
field_defaults.timeline_milestones: Typical: CR rounds → PRB submissions → final approval → trafficking.
field_defaults.appendix: UTM / naming: pillar, campaign, source LinkedIn, sub-source in-feed sponsored post, indication, branded/unbranded.

field_defaults.marketing_objectives: Educate HCPs on evolved clinical story; encourage deeper engagement with approved destination content.
field_defaults.tactic_objectives: Update branded HQ email used in calendar/trigger CRM programs; align narrative with cross-channel messaging.
field_defaults.deliverables:
Updated HTML email layout; desktop + mobile proof.
Subject lines + preheaders.
Optional: alignment with trigger program versioning.
field_defaults.story_flow: Salutation → concise body (often comparable length to legacy) → primary CTA → secondary if any → legal/footer.
field_defaults.copy_requirements:
Subject lines + preheaders; full indication ISI; state pricing/transparency footer lines where required.
Keep promotional audience statement and unsubscribe/privacy links.
field_defaults.art_pd_xd: Refresh hero/key visual from latest approved storyboard; HQ-specific template; CTA buttons not full-bleed — preserve side whitespace.
field_defaults.tech_dev_deployment:
UTMs on site CTAs for deployment partner tracking.
Build in ESP; test sends prior to final deployment partner send.
BRD/FRD to partner once business rules locked.
field_defaults.reviews: Multiple client reviews; PRB submissions with revisions; final approval and test sends via partner.
field_defaults.appendix: UTM grid (Excel); align naming with email deployment taxonomy.

field_defaults.marketing_objectives: Support appropriate HCP engagement following field interactions; drive to approved destination experiences.
field_defaults.tactic_objectives: Single branded Veeva Approved Email template with rep-customizable fields per FDM limits.
field_defaults.deliverables:
(1) Layout proof desktop/mobile.
(2) HTML Email Template (ET code) with assets zipped per platform guidance.
field_defaults.copy_requirements:
Pick lists: salutations; recipient name tokens; customizable intro/closing (character limits per policy).
Subject line options (e.g. 3–4); avoid restricted combinations if policy applies.
Primary CTA + supporting body per narrative.
field_defaults.art_pd_xd:
Match approved header style reference; light imagery so loads reliably in email.
Rep-section placeholders clearly delineated from fixed MLR blocks.
field_defaults.tech_dev_deployment: UTMs on web CTAs; HTML QA; assets + spacer gif to ET metadata folder structure; RegOps/account creates ET code; QC test blasts multi-device.
field_defaults.submission_files: Mockups align to routed HTML; subject suggestions documented.
field_defaults.reviews: Client layout reviews; PRB sequence without separate concept round unless required; distribution approval.
field_defaults.assumptions: Neon builds HTML to approved template patterns; assumes fixed number of test-send rounds with IT/Veeva staging.
field_defaults.exclusions: FDM submission outside agency scope unless separately scoped; extra review rounds change-order.
field_defaults.appendix: UTM naming; Veeva fields for campaign/indication/sub-source.

field_defaults.marketing_objectives: Enable paid social activation via compliant brand/unbranded presence; support retargeting journeys.
field_defaults.tactic_objectives: Create net-new professional-audience page to house ads; minimal or no organic publishing.
field_defaults.deliverables: Facebook (Meta) page setup: naming, handle, profile image, cover, About copy; pharma template; engagement disabled per policy.
field_defaults.specs_reference: Profile photo high-res square (~1200×1200 min); cover ~820×312 (note mobile crop); static imagery; HCP-only statement on cover.
field_defaults.mandatories: Unbranded look consistent with unbranded campaign; logos/sign-off per legal; disable comments/messenger/posts as approved.
field_defaults.reviews: Internal creative review; client L&F + mockup; PRB with screenshots; final approval; Meta engagement-disable via support request (lead time).
field_defaults.tech_dev_deployment: Social team builds dev page from setup sheet; creative refreshes screenshots before submission.
field_defaults.appendix: UTM conventions for subsequent paid posts; reference social placement guidelines deck if available.
